summary: Phase 3 fully verified. Backend pytest 6/6 PASSED (test_iter39_phase3.py): (1) Schoolgram comment ownership — siswa-B PATCH/DELETE on siswa-A's comment both return 403; owner PATCH sets edited=true + text persisted; super_admin DELETE of any comment allowed; comment doc now contains user_id. (2) Jadwal POST /timetable returns 409 for same-class+overlap, 409 for same-room cross-class overlap, 200 for non-overlapping; today-dated schedule retrievable via /timetable?class_id=... (frontend isLive logic is UI-side). (3) Inventory borrow flow — POST /borrow with past return_date + PATCH ?status=Disetujui yields {status:'Disetujui', return_date:<past>} so frontend derives 'Terlambat' (confirmed in Inventory.jsx line 189-192). (4) PPDB register w/o jurusan ok; PATCH /ppdb/{id}?status=lolos|tidak_lolos|pending persists, PATCH ?notes=... persists, parent_phone round-trips. (5) Elections — POST /vote/{cid} blocked (400) when election_config.status='belum' or 'selesai'; allowed when 'berlangsung'; stats.total_votes increments; participation increases; invalid status rejected (400); double-vote same position blocked (400). Frontend Playwright (super admin): login OK → Jadwal (jadwal-root, add modal with jadwal-subject/day/start/end/room/save all visible; view toggle button clickable — matrix table only renders when slots>0, else shows empty-state message, verified by inspecting MatrixView line 209) → Elections (election-quickcount, election-status-badge, election-status-control render; qc-total-dpt/suara-masuk/total-vote/partisipasi all present and populated; clicking election-status-berlangsung → badge becomes 'Sedang Berlangsung'; clicking election-status-belum → badge becomes 'Belum Dimulai') → Schoolgram password gate renders ('Masukkan ulang password … Buka Schoolgram') → Admin PPDB (seeded 1 pendaftar; ppdb-detail-{id} opens modal with ppdb-detail-status-pending/-lolos/-tidak_lolos buttons, ppdb-detail-note textarea, ppdb-detail-save-note button, ppdb-detail-wa link = https://wa.me/6281200000004?text=Halo%20Ortu%20UI..., status update + note save succeeded. ppdb-detail-docs section only renders when berkas present — expected).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py edit_comment (line 2380) allows ONLY owner — super_admin/kepsek cannot EDIT others' comments (they can only DELETE). This is intentional per PRD-like description, but inconsistent with delete_comment which allows admin override. Consider documenting this asymmetry.

_timetable_conflict (line 4278): class-conflict check short-circuits before teacher/room checks on the same iteration. If the same class has an overlapping entry, the error always says 'Bentrok dengan jadwal kelas …' even when the real cause for the admin would be a room clash — not blocking.

frontend 'Terlambat' derivation at Inventory.jsx line 188 uses `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` which is UTC date, not WIB (UTC+7). Around midnight WIB, items with return_date == 'today WIB' could display one state 7 hours later than expected.
Elections.jsx quickcount polls every 5s via fetch — ensure component cleans up interval on unmount to avoid orphan fetches when user navigates away (verified in previous iterations).
backend/server.py still ~4919 lines — refactor into modular routers remains outstanding (flagged in iteration_3).
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run: throwaway siswa (2-3), temporary class 'X-1' (if absent), transient PPDB, inventory item, borrow request, 2 candidates. All deleted in-test. Playwright run created 1 PPDB entry 'TEST UI PPDB <suffix>' not auto-cleaned — safe to delete manually or leave (does not affect metrics).
